metadata.title: Profile Portrait in Teal and Gold

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, side-profile portrait of a woman with long blonde hair, set against a textured, dark teal-green background. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting the contours of the face and the individual strands of hair while maintaining a moody, atmospheric depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm blonde hair vs. cool teal background
Sharp profile silhouette vs. soft-focus background texture
Bright highlights on hair vs. deep shadows in the background
coreInvariants: Soft-focus bokeh background with organic texture
Naturalistic skin texture and winged eyeliner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned off-center to the left, facing right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eye and the sharp line of the nose bridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the curve of the hair down to the profile, then follows the subject's gaze toward the right edge of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the right side, filled with a dark, mottled teal texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the hair highlights and the dark background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution profile portrait of a woman with long, straight blonde hair. The lighting should be soft, coming from the front-left to highlight the profile. The background should be a dark, out-of-focus teal wall with a subtle, mottled texture. The subject should have a neutral, slightly melancholic expression.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, elegant serif font placed in the negative space on the right, aligned vertically or centered to maintain the minimalist aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the background a dark, textured teal?
Is the hair color a natural-looking golden blonde?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no lens flare is present
Check that the hair strands look natural and not clumped
Verify the teal background has depth and isn't a flat color
Confirm the profile line is sharp against the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile subject + [Hair Color] + [Soft Directional Lighting] + [Textured Dark Background Color] + [Minimalist Composition]
